title: Mayupa patanpi kaq Guardian
intro: Huk tirano kamachikusqan askha wasikunaman llakikuyta apamusqan suyupi, huk alma chaskirqan huk willakuyta, chaymi llapa manchakuyta mana atiparqanchu. Confianzawan hunt’asqa sonqowanmi huk nacionpa puriyninta cambiananpaq iñiyninkupi ruwayta qallarirqanku. Yakukuna ancha valorniyoq cargata apashaqtinmi suyakuyqa corrientekunawan chaqrukurqan.
clues: Divina inspiraciontan chaskirqani, chaymi valorta qowarqan.
Wawayta huk cajaman churaspa yaku pataman churarqani.
Wawaytaqa kamachikuqpa wasinmi tarirurqa, huknin wawaymi ichaqa qatirqa.
Wawaywanmi hukmanta huñunakurqani ñuñuchinaypaq, imaynan Allah prometewarqan hinata.

outcome.label: Tukusqa
options: Chay wawataqa huk qhapaq qhatuqmi adoptarqan

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
